section.content: 本发明涉及种生物基因检测器具，包括玻璃培养皿，所述玻璃培养皿上安装有分类组件和单向输入管，所述分类组件包括分隔条和玻璃环，所述分隔条安装在玻璃培养皿的下端，所述玻璃环位于玻璃培养皿的上部，玻璃环内安装有隔网，所述单向输入管的上端安装有夹持座，所述玻璃培养皿与单向输入管上端通过夹持座连接，且夹持座与玻璃培养皿为体结构。本发明通过设置玻璃培养皿、单向输入管和夹持座有助于存放检测液及输入待测试剂并固定装置整体的位置，通过设置分类组件有助于增加分类检测空间。

The present invention relates to a kind of biological gene to detect utensil, including glass culture dish, classification component and unidirectional input pipe are installed on the glass culture dish, the classification component includes divider and glass ring, the divider is arranged on the lower end of glass culture dish, the glass ring is located at the top of glass culture dish, filter is installed in glass ring, the upper end of the unidirectional input pipe is provided with grip slipper, the glass culture dish is connected with unidirectional input pipe upper end by grip slipper, and grip slipper is structure as a whole with glass culture dish.The present invention is by setting glass culture dish, unidirectional input pipe and grip slipper to contribute to storage detection liquid and inputting the test agent simultaneously overall position of fixing device, by setting classification component to help to increase classification and Detection space.

The present invention relates to biological gene engineering device design technical field, more particularly to a kind of biological gene detection utensil.

Background technology

As the preferred technical solution of the present invention, the glass culture dish is connected with unidirectional input pipe upper end by grip slipper Connect, and grip slipper is structure as a whole with glass culture dish.

As the preferred technical solution of the present invention, the material of the filter is plastics.
